name: Okta Vendor App Linked to Overdue Vendor Review
description: Detects active Okta SaaS or vendor-facing applications whose matching GRC vendor record has no security owner or an overdue security review.
query: WITH vendor_apps AS (SELECT app.id AS app_id, COALESCE(app.label, app.name, app.id) AS app_name, app.sign_on_mode, app.status FROM okta_applications app WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(app.status, 'active')) IN ('active', 'enabled') AND NOT LOWER(COALESCE(app.label, app.name, '')) RLIKE '.*(test|sandbox|dev|internal).*' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(app.sign_on_mode, '')) RLIKE '.*(saml|oidc|oauth).*' OR LOWER(COALESCE(app.label, app.name, '')) RLIKE '.*(org2org|vendor|partner|supplier|contractor|external).*')) SELECT va.app_id AS id, va.app_name, v.id AS vendor_id, v.name AS vendor_name, v.security_owner_user_id, v.next_security_review_due_date FROM vendor_apps va JOIN vendors v ON LOWER(COALESCE(v.name, '')) = LOWER(va.app_name) WHERE COALESCE(v.security_owner_user_id, '') = '' OR v.next_security_review_due_date IS NULL OR v.next_security_review_due_date < NOW()
remediation: Assign a security owner, complete or update the vendor security review, and confirm the Okta application remains approved for use.
